questions.question: Today is Coffee Day. Roughly how many roasted beans go into a typical single shot of espresso?
questions.sourceNote: ~8g of coffee per shot. 1 roasted bean ≈ 0.13g. 8g / 0.13g ≈ 61 beans. Call it ~60.

questions.question: Roughly how many photos are taken worldwide on smartphones every single day?
questions.sourceNote: With ~5 billion smartphone users worldwide, an average of 1 photo per person per day gets us to 5 billion.

questions.question: When a woodpecker is drumming on a tree, roughly how many times does it peck per second?
questions.sourceNote: Woodpeckers drum at astonishing speeds—up to 20 pecks per second—to communicate and defend territory.

questions.question: Roughly how many millilitres of saliva does an average adult produce in a single day?
questions.sourceNote: Humans produce ~0.5 to 1.5 liters (500-1500 ml) of saliva daily, peaking at meals and dropping heavily at night.
questions.didYouKnow: Your body drastically reduces saliva production while you sleep. This dry environment allows bacteria to thrive, which is exactly why we wake up with morning breath!

questions.question: How many physical keys (black and white combined) are on a standard modern grand piano?
questions.sourceNote: Standard modern pianos have exactly 52 white keys and 36 black keys.

questions.question: It's autumn walk season. Roughly how many leaves drop from a single mature, healthy oak tree?
questions.sourceNote: Assume 10 main branches × 10 sub-branches × 100 twigs × 25 leaves ≈ 250,000 leaves per tree.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual unpopped kernels are inside a standard bag of microwave popcorn?
questions.sourceNote: A standard bag yields ~10 cups of popped corn. At roughly 35 kernels per popped cup, 10 × 35 ≈ 350 kernels.

questions.question: How many times does a honeybee flap its wings in a single minute?
questions.sourceNote: Bees flap their wings at about 230 beats per second. 230 beats × 60 seconds = 13,800 flaps per minute.
questions.didYouKnow: A bee's incredibly rapid wingbeats create tiny, rapid 'hurricanes' that generate aerodynamic lift, a feat that puzzled physicists for decades.

questions.question: If you follow dentist advice for an 80-year lifespan, how many total continuous days will you have spent brushing your teeth?
questions.sourceNote: 4 mins/day × 365 = 1,460 mins (24.3 hours) per year. That's about 1 full day per year, so ~80 days over an 80-year life!

questions.question: How many individual frames make up an exactly two-hour cinematic movie shot at the standard 24 frames per second?
questions.sourceNote: 120 minutes × 60 seconds = 7,200 seconds total. 7,200 seconds × 24 frames per second = 172,800 individual images.

questions.question: Playing a round this weekend? Roughly how many dimples are on a standard golf ball?
questions.sourceNote: Most standard balls have between 300 and 400 dimples for optimal aerodynamics, with 336 being the most classic symmetrical pattern.

questions.question: Roughly how many tiny seeds are on the outside of an average strawberry?
questions.sourceNote: Visually estimating, a medium strawberry has about 10-15 vertical rows of seeds, with ~15 seeds per row, totaling around 200 seeds.

questions.question: Roughly how many streams does a song need on Spotify to earn an artist a single US dollar?
questions.sourceNote: Spotify pays on average $0.003 to $0.005 per stream. Doing the math: $1.00 / $0.004 = 250 streams.
questions.didYouKnow: Artists don't actually get paid a fixed rate per stream. Royalties are pooled and divided based on stream share per country and subscription type.

questions.question: Roughly how many sharp, defensive quills cover a typical adult North American porcupine?
questions.sourceNote: A porcupine's back and tail have around 100-150 quills per square inch over roughly 200-300 square inches of body area, giving ~30,000 total.

questions.question: Roughly how many times does an average person check or unlock their smartphone every single day?
questions.sourceNote: Assuming 16 awake hours (960 minutes), checking a phone every 6 to 7 minutes translates to about 144 checks per day.

questions.question: Roughly how many minutes does it take the International Space Station to complete one full orbit around Earth?
questions.sourceNote: Low Earth orbit takes ~90 mins, meaning the ISS completes about 16 full orbits around the planet every single day.

questions.question: Today is World Animal Day! Roughly how many individual dark spots dot the coat of an average adult cheetah?
questions.sourceNote: A typical adult cheetah has between 2,000 and 3,000 solid black spots covering its body to help camouflage in the savannah grass.
questions.didYouKnow: A cheetah's spots are essentially a camouflage pattern meant to mimic shadows in tall grass, and no two cats have the exact same pattern.

questions.question: Roughly how many times does a typical, healthy adult fart in a single day?
questions.sourceNote: Medical consensus says passing gas 10 to 20 times a day is perfectly normal for a healthy adult, releasing up to 1.5 liters of gas.

questions.question: Roughly how many standard pepperoni slices come on a typical large 14-inch delivery pizza?
questions.sourceNote: A 14-inch pizza has an area of ~153 sq in. Major pizza chains usually aim for about 30-40 pepperonis per large pie to ensure every slice has enough.

questions.question: Roughly how many hours of new video content are uploaded to YouTube every single minute?
questions.sourceNote: YouTube reports that over 500 hours of video are uploaded per minute globally, roughly equating to 720,000 hours of new content every day.

questions.question: Dragging yourself to Monday lectures? Roughly how many steps does a typical university student take over a full four-year degree?
questions.sourceNote: ~10,000 daily steps × 365 days × 4 years ≈ 1.46×10^7 steps across a standard degree.

questions.question: A standard 12-inch vinyl LP plays at 33 ⅓ RPM. Roughly how many total times does the record physically spin during a 22-minute side?
questions.sourceNote: 33.33 revolutions per minute × 22 minutes of playback time = 733.26 total physical spins.

questions.question: Roughly how many teeth does a great white shark naturally lose and replace over a typical 30-year lifespan?
questions.sourceNote: Sharks lose ~1 to 2 teeth a day from their multiple rows. 1.5 teeth × 365 days × 30 years ≈ 16,500 to 20,000 teeth.
questions.didYouKnow: Sharks are on an endless dental conveyor belt. New rows of teeth constantly move forward from the back of the jaw to replace old ones.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual French fries come inside a standard medium-sized cardboard portion from McDonald's?
questions.sourceNote: A medium fry portion weighs ~110 grams. If an average shoestring fry weighs 1.5 grams, that equals roughly 70-80 individual fries.

questions.question: Roughly how many times does a car's windshield wiper swipe back and forth during a continuous hour of driving in steady rain?
questions.sourceNote: On a medium steady setting, wipers swipe about 40 times per minute. 40 swipes/min × 60 minutes = 2,400 total swipes.

questions.question: If you unspooled a standard packet of instant ramen, roughly how many meters of noodles would you get?
questions.sourceNote: A block has about 80 folds, each roughly 10cm long, stacked in multiple layers. Unspooled, a single pack of ramen reaches about 50 meters!

questions.question: Roughly how many hungry mosquitoes would it take to drink all the blood in an average adult human?
questions.sourceNote: A human has ~5L (5,000,000 µL) of blood. A typical mosquito drinks around 5 µL per bite. 5,000,000 ÷ 5 = 1 million thirsty bugs!

questions.question: If you type a solid 60 words per minute, roughly how many individual keystrokes do you make in an hour?
questions.sourceNote: Typing tests assume 5 keystrokes per 'word'. 60 words/min = 300 strokes per minute. 300 strokes × 60 minutes = 18,000 total keystrokes.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual candies are inside a standard, regular-sized checkout bag of plain M&M's?
questions.sourceNote: A standard bag is about 1.69 oz (48 grams). A single plain M&M weighs just under 1 gram, averaging out to roughly 55 candies per bag.

questions.question: Whether we remember them or not, roughly how many total dreams does an average person have over an 80-year lifetime?
questions.sourceNote: We typically cycle through REM sleep 4 to 6 times a night, meaning ~5 dreams per night. 5 × 365 days × 80 years ≈ 146,000 dreams.
questions.didYouKnow: You actually dream every single night, even if you wake up swearing your mind was totally blank. Most dreams are forgotten within 5 minutes of waking!

questions.question: Roughly how many fluffy cotton bolls must be harvested to make a single standard adult t-shirt?
questions.sourceNote: A t-shirt needs ~150g of usable cotton. One mature cotton boll yields about 0.75g of clean lint. 150g ÷ 0.75g ≈ 200 bolls.

questions.question: Without even thinking about it, roughly how many times do you swallow your own saliva in a 24-hour day?
questions.sourceNote: You swallow about 1-2 times per minute awake (~1,000 times in 16 hours) but rarely while asleep. The medical average is ~600-900 times daily.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual sesame seeds are baked onto the top of a typical fast-food burger bun?
questions.sourceNote: A 1-inch square has ~35 seeds. A typical 3.5-inch diameter bun top has roughly 10 square inches of surface area. 10 × ~35 ≈ 350-400 seeds.

questions.question: Roughly how many live earthworms are wriggling in the topsoil beneath a single acre of green lawn?
questions.sourceNote: Healthy soil holds ~100-150 worms per square meter. An acre is roughly 4,000 square meters. 4,000 × 125 ≈ 500,000 worms per acre.
questions.didYouKnow: Charles Darwin was so fascinated by earthworms he dedicated an entire book to them, estimating they turn over up to 18 tons of soil per acre every year!

questions.question: If you could walk directly upwards at a brisk pace without stopping, how many days would it take to reach the Moon?
questions.sourceNote: The Moon is ~384,000 km away. A brisk walk is 5 km/h. 384,000 ÷ 5 = 76,800 hours. 76,800 ÷ 24 hours ≈ 3,200 continuous days (nearly 9 years).

questions.question: Roughly how many standard frozen fish fingers can be made from a single average adult Atlantic cod?
questions.sourceNote: ~5kg cod × 40% edible meat yield = 2kg of fish. A standard fish finger has ~25g of fish. 2000g ÷ 25g = 80.
questions.didYouKnow: A large female Atlantic cod can release up to 9 million eggs in a single spawning season, though only a tiny fraction survive to adulthood.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual thumb taps does it take to type out a standard 50-word text message?
questions.sourceNote: ~5 letters per word × 50 words = 250 letters + 49 spaces + ~10 backspaces or punctuation marks ≈ 300 total taps.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual peanuts are shelled and ground up to make a standard 12-ounce jar of peanut butter?
questions.sourceNote: The National Peanut Board estimates about 540 peanuts per 12-oz jar. That's a dense 45 peanuts crammed into every single ounce!

questions.question: Before getting too ragged and retired, roughly how many times does a physical US one-dollar bill change hands?
questions.sourceNote: The Fed puts a $1 bill's lifespan at ~6.6 years. If it's used in a transaction about twice a week: 2 times × 52 weeks × 6.6 years ≈ 686 exchanges.

questions.question: If you stick a typical pop song on repeat for a full 8-hour workday, roughly how many times will it play?
questions.sourceNote: An average modern pop song is roughly 3.5 minutes long. 8 hours × 60 minutes = 480 minutes total. 480 ÷ 3.5 ≈ 137 plays.

questions.question: Roughly how many packages and parcels are delivered worldwide every single second?
questions.sourceNote: Global parcel volume hit ~160 billion per year recently. 160 billion ÷ 365 days ÷ 24 hours ÷ 3600 seconds ≈ 5,073 packages per second.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual sweat glands are scattered across an average adult human body?
questions.sourceNote: Humans have an average skin surface area of ~1.8 square meters, packed with roughly 150 to 300 sweat glands per square centimeter, totaling ~3 million.
questions.didYouKnow: Humans are the sweatiest primates on Earth. It's an evolutionary superpower that let early humans jog after furry prey until the animals collapsed from heat stroke.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual strands of dry pasta are inside a standard 500g box of spaghetti?
questions.sourceNote: A standard 100g portion of typical supermarket spaghetti contains around 100 individual strands, making a 500g box roughly 500 strands.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual glowing pixels make up the screen of a standard 4K television?
questions.sourceNote: Standard 4K UHD resolution is exactly 3,840 pixels wide by 2,160 pixels tall. 3,840 × 2,160 = 8,294,400 pixels.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual feathers cover a typical adult city pigeon?
questions.sourceNote: Small songbirds have ~2,000 feathers, and swans have ~25,000. Researchers counting plumage on typical rock doves (pigeons) find an average of ~7,100.

questions.question: Struggling to sleep? If you lie awake and count one sheep every single second, how many would you count over a full 8 hours?
questions.sourceNote: 60 seconds/minute × 60 minutes/hour × 8 hours = 28,800 total sheep counted.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual grapes must be picked and crushed to produce a single standard bottle of wine?
questions.sourceNote: It takes ~2.5 lbs (1,133g) of grapes per bottle. At ~1.5g per grape, 1,133g ÷ 1.5g ≈ 750 grapes.

questions.question: Roughly how many round suction cups line the eight arms of an adult Giant Pacific Octopus?
questions.sourceNote: 8 arms per octopus × roughly 280 suckers per mature arm ≈ 2,240 suction cups in total.
questions.didYouKnow: The largest suckers near the beak of a Giant Pacific Octopus are incredibly strong—a single sucker can lift up to 35 pounds (16 kg) on its own!

questions.question: Running a 26.2-mile marathon, roughly how many times do your feet strike the pavement from start to finish?
questions.sourceNote: An average runner takes ~2,100 steps per mile. 26.2 miles × 2,100 steps/mile ≈ 55,000 total footfalls.

questions.question: If you binged every aired episode of The Simpsons back-to-back without resting, roughly how many full days would it take?
questions.sourceNote: ~760 episodes × 22 mins/episode ≈ 16,720 mins. 16,720 mins ÷ 60 = 278 hours ÷ 24 hours/day ≈ 11.6 days.

questions.question: How many times does an astronaut on the International Space Station watch the sun set over the course of a full year?
questions.sourceNote: 1 orbit takes ~90 mins. 24 hrs / 1.5 = 16 orbits a day. 16 sunsets × 365 days = 5,840.
questions.didYouKnow: Because the ISS travels at 17,500 mph, astronauts see 16 sunrises and 16 sunsets every 24 hours. Their sleep schedules are heavily regulated to cope!

questions.question: Roughly how many meters do you physically scroll with your thumb on your smartphone screen on an average day?
questions.sourceNote: ~1 hour active scroll × 60 mins × 30 swipes/min × ~0.05m (2 inches) per swipe ≈ 90 meters.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual potato chips are inside a standard large party-size bag from the supermarket?
questions.sourceNote: A party bag weighs ~370g. An average potato chip weighs ~2.5g. 370 ÷ 2.5 ≈ 148, rounding up to 150 chips per bag.

questions.question: Roughly how many liters of air do you breathe in and out over a typical 24-hour day?
questions.sourceNote: ~15 breaths/min × 60 mins × 24 hrs = 21,600 breaths/day. 21,600 × ~0.5 liters per breath = ~10,800 liters.

questions.question: If a hummingbird hovers continuously, roughly how many times does it flap its wings in a single hour?
questions.sourceNote: An average hummingbird beats its wings ~50 times per second. 50 × 60 seconds = 3,000 per minute. 3,000 × 60 minutes = 180,000 flaps per hour.

questions.question: Starting your Monday with an omelette? Roughly how many eggs does a typical commercial laying hen produce in a single year?
questions.sourceNote: A healthy commercial hen lays about 1 egg nearly every day, minus a few resting or molting weeks. ~6 days/week × 50 weeks ≈ 300 eggs.

questions.question: Roughly how many rapid eye movements, or "saccades," do your eyes naturally make during a normal 16-hour waking day?
questions.sourceNote: Our eyes dart around constantly to build a mental picture, averaging about 3 saccades per second. 3 × 60s × 60m × 16 hours ≈ 172,800.

questions.question: Digging straight down in modern Minecraft, exactly how many blocks make up a single full 16-by-16 chunk from bedrock to the sky limit?
questions.sourceNote: A chunk's footprint is 16 by 16 blocks. In recent updates, the total world height goes from -64 to 320, totaling 384 blocks. 16 × 16 × 384 = 98,304.

questions.question: Roughly how many of our Moons could you squish inside the Earth by volume?
questions.sourceNote: Earth's diameter is roughly 3.7 times larger than the Moon's. Since volume scales by the cube of the radius, 3.7³ ≈ 50.

questions.question: If you run your thumbnail along the outer edge of a standard US quarter, exactly how many tiny ridges will you count?
questions.sourceNote: The US Mint manufactures standard quarters with exactly 119 ridges. (Dimes have slightly fewer at 118!)
questions.didYouKnow: The ridges, known as "reeding," were originally added to silver and gold coins to stop thieves from quietly shaving off the precious metal edges.

questions.question: With Halloween approaching, how many individual Skittles can you cram inside an empty 2-liter soda bottle?
questions.sourceNote: ~2000mL bottle. Skittle volume ~0.7mL. Assuming ~65% packing efficiency for irregular spheres: (2000 × 0.65) / 0.7 ≈ 1850.

questions.question: Assuming you have a full head of hair, roughly how many strands do you naturally shed in a year?
questions.sourceNote: A healthy adult sheds roughly 50 to 100 hairs a day. Taking an average of ~75 hairs × 365 days ≈ 27,375 hairs per year.

questions.question: Roughly how many microscopic teeth are lined up inside the mouth of an average garden snail?
questions.sourceNote: A snail's radula (tongue) has ~100 rows of teeth, with ~140 teeth per row. 100 × 140 = 14,000 microscopic chitin teeth used for scraping.
questions.didYouKnow: Snails don't chew! They use a ribbon-like tongue called a radula, covered in thousands of microscopic teeth, to scrape and shred their food.

questions.question: Roughly how many hours of new music are uploaded to Spotify every single day?
questions.sourceNote: Spotify sees ~100,000 new tracks daily. At an average of ~3 minutes per track, that is 300,000 minutes, or roughly 5,000 hours of new music a day.

questions.question: If you skip the elevator, exactly how many physical steps do you climb to reach the 102nd floor of the Empire State Building?
questions.sourceNote: The building has 102 floors. At roughly 18 steps per floor on average, the official count to the 102nd floor observatory is exactly 1,860 steps.

questions.question: Lining them up heel-to-toe, roughly how many average adult running shoes would it take to complete one lap of a 400-meter track?
questions.sourceNote: ~30 cm (0.3m) per shoe. A standard track is 400 meters long. 400 / 0.3 ≈ 1,333 shoes.

questions.question: If you shouted at the top of your lungs, roughly how many seconds would it take for the sound to travel exactly one mile?
questions.sourceNote: Sound travels through air at roughly 343 meters per second. One mile is roughly 1,609 meters. 1,609 / 343 ≈ 4.7 seconds.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual, juicy yellow kernels are packed onto a typical full ear of sweet corn?
questions.sourceNote: A typical ear of corn has about 16 rows around, and each row contains about 50 kernels from end to end. 16 x 50 = 800.
questions.didYouKnow: An ear of corn almost always grows an even number of rows (usually 16) because the cells divide in pairs during the early stages of development.

questions.question: If you count them all up, exactly how many individual dots or 'pips' are printed across a standard double-six set of 28 dominoes?
questions.sourceNote: Each number 1-6 appears 8 times across the set. The sum of 1+2+3+4+5+6 is 21. Multiply 21 by 8 to get 168 dots.

questions.question: Staring at the screen, roughly how many times do you naturally blink your eyes while watching a standard two-hour movie?
questions.sourceNote: An average person blinks about 15 times a minute to keep their eyes lubricated. Over a 120-minute movie, 15 x 120 = 1,800 blinks.

questions.question: It's Global Handwashing Day! Roughly how many pumps of liquid soap do you get out of a standard 250ml bathroom dispenser?
questions.sourceNote: A standard liquid soap dispenser dispenses about 1.5ml of soap per pump. 250ml / 1.5ml = 166.6 pumps.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual flower blossoms must bees visit to produce a standard 1kg jar of honey?
questions.sourceNote: A bee gets ~0.02g of nectar per visit, and it takes about 2-3g of nectar to make 1g of honey. 1000g of honey × 4,000 visits/g ≈ 4,000,000 blossoms.

questions.question: Roughly how many kilometers do you hurtle through space around the sun during a standard 8-hour sleep?
questions.sourceNote: The Earth travels at approximately 107,000 km/h in its orbit around the sun. 107,000 km/h × 8 hours = 856,000 kilometers.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual vibrations does a cat's voice box make during one minute of happy purring?
questions.sourceNote: Cats purr at a frequency of 25 to 30 Hertz (vibrations per second). 25 Hz × 60 seconds = 1,500 vibrations.
questions.didYouKnow: Domestic cats purr at frequencies between 25 and 30 Hertz, a range that has been shown in studies to promote tissue regeneration and bone healing.

questions.question: Whether you're a chatterbox or quiet, roughly how many words does an average adult speak in a typical day?
questions.sourceNote: Studies show humans speak ~15,000-16,000 words daily. At a conversational rate of ~130 words/min, that's about 2 hours of active talking.

questions.question: Today is World Food Day. Roughly how many individual baked beans are packed into a standard 400g tin?
questions.sourceNote: ~1g per bean, but a 400g can is about 50-60% beans and 40% sauce by weight. 220g of beans gives you roughly 420 to 450 individual beans.

questions.question: If you recreated Pixar's Up, roughly how many standard party balloons would you need to lift an 80kg human?
questions.sourceNote: 1L of helium lifts ~1g. A standard balloon holds ~14L (14g lift). For an 80kg (80,000g) adult: 80,000 / 14 ≈ 5,714 balloons.
questions.didYouKnow: In Pixar's Up, animators actually modeled exactly 20,622 individual balloons to lift Carl's house for the initial lift-off sequence!

questions.question: Roughly how many times will an average person yawn over an 80-year lifetime?
questions.sourceNote: Humans average about 5 to 10 yawns a day. If we guess 8 yawns daily: 8 yawns × 365 days × 80 years ≈ 233,600 lifelong yawns.

questions.question: Roughly how many characters, including spaces, are printed in a standard 300-page paperback novel?
questions.sourceNote: A typical book has ~250 words per page. 300 pages = 75,000 words. At ~6 characters per word (including spaces), that's ~450,000 characters.

questions.question: If you pluck a perfectly tuned standard A string on a guitar and let it ring for 3 seconds, how many times does it vibrate?
questions.sourceNote: A standard A string is tuned to 440 Hertz, meaning it vibrates 440 times per second. Over 3 seconds, that's 440 × 3 = 1,320 vibrations.

questions.question: Roughly how many physical ATM cash machines are currently installed and operating worldwide?
questions.sourceNote: ~1 ATM per 2,500 people globally. 8 billion people / 2,500 ≈ 3.2 million cash machines worldwide.

questions.question: Even if you never cry, roughly how many individual teardrops do your eyes naturally produce to stay moist over a full year?
questions.sourceNote: ~15 gallons of basal tears per year ≈ 57,000 mL. At roughly 20 drops per mL, that's about 1.1 million individual drops.

questions.question: A sea otter has the thickest fur in the animal kingdom. Roughly how many individual hairs cover an average adult's entire body?
questions.sourceNote: ~1 million hairs per square inch. An adult otter has a surface area of roughly 900-1,000 square inches. 1M × 900 = 900 million.
questions.didYouKnow: While humans have about 100,000 hairs on their head, sea otters pack up to 1 million hairs into a single square inch of skin to stay warm in freezing oceans.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual fresh blueberries are packed into a standard pint-sized supermarket container?
questions.sourceNote: A standard US dry pint of berries weighs about 310 grams. At roughly 1.5 grams per blueberry, that's just over 200 berries.

questions.question: During a chaotic 15-minute session of Mario Kart, roughly how many individual button presses or steering inputs do you make?
questions.sourceNote: ~1.5 to 2 steering adjustments, drifts, or item throws per second. 1.7 inputs × 60 seconds × 15 minutes ≈ 1,500 total actions.

questions.question: If you could drive a car straight up into space at 60 mph, roughly how many years would it take to reach the Sun?
questions.sourceNote: ~93 million miles to the Sun / 60 mph = 1,550,000 hours. Divided by 24 hours and 365 days ≈ 177 years of non-stop driving.

questions.question: Roughly how many brand new red blood cells is your body producing right this very second?
questions.sourceNote: The human body produces about 2 million red blood cells every second to replace dying ones, adding up to nearly 200 billion daily.
questions.didYouKnow: Your body is a factory constantly replacing old cells. In the time it took you to read this, you made around 10 million new red blood cells!

questions.question: If you chew a piece of gum for 30 minutes, roughly how many times do your jaws chomp down?
questions.sourceNote: ~1 chew per second × 60 seconds per minute × 30 minutes = 1,800 jaw movements for a standard half-hour gum session.

questions.question: Roughly how many Google searches are being typed and submitted worldwide every single second?
questions.sourceNote: With over 8.5 billion searches processed per day, dividing by 24 hours, 60 mins, and 60 secs yields roughly 98,000 to 100,000 searches a second.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual ants live together inside a typical large fire ant mound?
questions.sourceNote: A mature fire ant mound typically contains anywhere between 100,000 and 500,000 worker ants, with ~250,000 being a solid average estimate.

questions.question: Nursing a Monday coffee? Roughly how many individual drops of liquid make up a standard 12-ounce mug?
questions.sourceNote: 1 fluid oz ≈ 30 mL. 1 mL ≈ 20 drops. 12 oz × 30 mL/oz × 20 drops/mL ≈ 7,200 drops.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual nylon bristles are packed onto the head of a standard manual toothbrush?
questions.sourceNote: A typical toothbrush has ~40 little tufts of bristles, with roughly 60 individual nylon strands per tuft. 40 × 60 ≈ 2,400.

questions.question: If you could drive a constant 60 mph, roughly how many continuous days would it take to circle the Earth's equator?
questions.sourceNote: Earth's equator is ~24,900 miles long. At 60 mph, that's 415 hours of continuous driving. 415 hours ÷ 24 hours/day ≈ 17.3 days.

questions.question: Exactly how many red double-stitches hold together the leather cover of an official Major League baseball?
questions.sourceNote: Official MLB rules require exactly 108 double-stitches (or 216 individual stitches) on every single ball used in play.
questions.didYouKnow: Every single MLB baseball is still hand-sewn today. Machines simply can't replicate the exact tension needed for pitchers to throw breaking balls!

questions.question: Roughly how many standard SMS text messages are sent worldwide every single minute?
questions.sourceNote: Roughly 23 billion traditional SMS messages are sent daily around the world. 23 billion ÷ 24 hours ÷ 60 minutes ≈ 16 million per minute.

questions.question: Cooking dinner tonight? Roughly how many individual grains of salt are scooped up in a standard level teaspoon?
questions.sourceNote: ~5 grams per tsp. An average grain of table salt weighs about 0.06 milligrams. 5g / 0.00006g ≈ 83,000 grains.

questions.question: Roughly how many physical times does a washing machine drum spin around during a standard 45-minute cycle?
questions.sourceNote: Wash/rinse: ~30 mins at ~50 rpm (1,500). Spin dry: ~15 mins at ~1,000 rpm (15,000). 15,000 + 1,500 = 16,500 spins.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual blades of grass are growing in a single lush, one-square-foot patch of lawn?
questions.sourceNote: A healthy lawn packs about 20 to 30 blades of grass per square inch. 144 square inches × ~21 blades ≈ 3,000 blades.

questions.question: Roughly how many commercial passenger flights take off worldwide on a typical bustling travel day?
questions.sourceNote: Global aviation networks handle around 100,000 scheduled commercial passenger flights daily.
questions.didYouKnow: While there are about 100,000 commercial passenger flights, if you add cargo, private, and military planes, the daily total jumps to over 200,000!

questions.question: Roughly how many individual heartbeats happen in your chest during a solid 8-hour night of deep sleep?
questions.sourceNote: During sleep, resting heart rates drop. ~55 beats per minute × 60 minutes × 8 hours ≈ 26,400 beats.

questions.seasonalNote: October 21, 2015 is the exact date Marty McFly travels to in Back to the Future Part II.
questions.question: Today is Back to the Future Day! To generate Doc Brown's 1.21 gigawatts, roughly how many AA batteries would you need to wire together?
questions.sourceNote: ~1.5 volts × 1 amp peak = 1.5 watts per AA battery. 1.21 billion watts ÷ 1.5 watts ≈ 800 million batteries to time travel!

questions.question: If you watch a golden retriever shake itself dry after a swim, roughly how many times does its body twist back and forth per second?
questions.sourceNote: Physics studies show mammals shake at specific frequencies based on size. A typical dog twists at 4 to 5 Hz (times per second) to efficiently fling off water.
questions.didYouKnow: Mammals instinctively tune their shake speed to their size! A bear shakes at 4 Hz, a dog at 5 Hz, but a tiny mouse vibrates at an incredible 27 times per second to stay warm.

questions.question: Exactly how many standard Lego bricks snapped together does it take to build a single tower reaching a standard 8-foot ceiling?
questions.sourceNote: An 8-foot ceiling is 96 inches, or exactly 2438.4 millimeters. A standard Lego brick is exactly 9.6 mm tall. 2438.4 ÷ 9.6 = exactly 254 bricks.

questions.question: Roughly how many microscopic dead skin cells do you naturally shed into the air and onto your clothes every single hour?
questions.sourceNote: Dermatologists estimate humans shed around 35,000 dead skin cells every minute. 35,000 cells × 60 minutes = 2.1 million cells dropped an hour.

questions.question: Roughly how many gallons of aviation fuel does a massive Boeing 747 burn from takeoff to landing on a typical 10-hour flight?
questions.sourceNote: A 747 burns roughly 1 gallon of jet fuel per second of flight. A 10-hour journey equals 36,000 seconds, requiring about 36,000 gallons.

questions.question: At a standard 50 words per minute, roughly how many continuous hours would it take to retype all seven Harry Potter books?
questions.sourceNote: ~1.08 million words ÷ 50 words per minute = 21,600 minutes. Divide by 60 minutes in an hour = 360 hours of non-stop typing.

questions.question: Roughly how many sharp green needles are attached to a fully grown, healthy pine tree?
questions.sourceNote: ~50 major branches × 200 secondary branches × 100 twig ends × 5 needles per cluster ≈ 5,000,000 needles on a large mature tree.

questions.question: Roughly how many tiny colorful sprinkles cover a standard frosted donut from your local bakery?
questions.sourceNote: Top surface area is ~50 cm². Sprinkles are tiny (~0.02 cm²). With about 15-20% scattered coverage, that fits around 400 sprinkles per donut.

questions.question: If you combined the growth of every strand on your head, roughly how many feet of new hair do you sprout in a single day?
questions.sourceNote: ~100,000 hairs × 0.5 inches/month ÷ 30 days ≈ 1,666 inches/day. Divided by 12 inches ≈ 138 feet of hair grown daily!
questions.didYouKnow: Even though a single hair only grows about half an inch a month, your 100,000 follicles work together to produce over 40 meters of new hair daily.

questions.question: If you count up all the colorful bills, exactly how much total cash comes inside a standard modern Monopoly box?
questions.sourceNote: Modern sets include 30 of each bill: $500, $100, $50, $20, $10, $5, and $1. That’s $686 in each stack. 30 × $686 = exactly $20,580.

questions.question: If you magically shrunk the Sun down to the size of a standard basketball, roughly how many meters away would the Earth orbit?
questions.sourceNote: The Sun's diameter is ~1.4M km, Earth is ~150M km away (107x further). A basketball is ~24cm across. 24cm × 107 = 2,568cm or ~26 meters.

questions.question: Roughly how many tiny microscopic taste buds are dotting the surface of an average adult's tongue?
questions.sourceNote: Adults have between 2,000 and 8,000 taste buds. Using the middle ground gives roughly 5,000 total buds.
questions.didYouKnow: Your taste buds are constantly dying and regenerating! The lifespan of a single bud is only about 10 days, meaning you get a fresh sense of taste multiple times a month.

questions.question: Roughly how many physical mouse clicks and key presses does a pro esports player make during a single one-hour match?
questions.sourceNote: Pro gamers average ~300 actions per minute (APM). 300 actions × 60 minutes = 18,000 physical inputs per hour.

questions.question: Cruising the highway at 60 mph, roughly how many times does a standard car tire physically spin around during a 30-minute drive?
questions.sourceNote: A standard tire has a ~6ft circumference. 30 mins at 60mph covers 30 miles (158,400 ft). 158,400 ft ÷ 6ft per spin = 26,400 spins.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual drops of water does it take to completely fill a standard Olympic-sized swimming pool?
questions.sourceNote: An Olympic pool holds ~2.5 million liters. With ~20 drops per milliliter (20,000 per liter), 2.5M × 20,000 = 50 billion drops.

questions.question: Navigating the city crowds this weekend? Roughly how many traffic lights are installed across all five boroughs of New York City?
questions.sourceNote: NYC has about 300 square miles of land. If dense areas have ~100 lights/sq mi and outer areas ~30/sq mi, we get around 13,200 total.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual eggs does a healthy queen bee lay in a single day during the peak of summer?
questions.sourceNote: A queen bee lays about 1 to 2 eggs per minute during peak season. 1.5 eggs × 60 mins × 24 hours ≈ 2,160.
questions.didYouKnow: During the peak summer foraging season, a healthy queen bee can lay her own body weight in eggs every single day.

questions.question: If you painstakingly counted them, roughly how many individual grains of rice are inside a standard 1kg supermarket bag?
questions.sourceNote: A single grain of long-grain white rice weighs about 0.02 grams. 1,000 grams ÷ 0.02 grams per grain = 50,000 grains.

questions.question: Exactly how many individual bones make up both of your hands and both of your feet combined?
questions.sourceNote: There are 27 bones in each hand (54) and 26 in each foot (52). Combined, that's 106—more than half of the 206 total bones in the body!

questions.question: Sitting down for board game night, exactly how many square spaces make up the grid on a standard Scrabble board?
questions.sourceNote: A standard Scrabble board is a perfect 15 by 15 square grid. 15 × 15 = 225 total spaces for tiles.

questions.question: Making comfort food—roughly how many individual dried elbow macaroni noodles are in a standard one-pound box?
questions.sourceNote: One cup of dried macaroni is ~140g and holds ~400 noodles. A 1lb box (454g) is ~3.25 cups. 3.25 × 400 ≈ 1,300 individual pieces.

questions.question: If you neatly stacked one million brand-new US dollar bills, roughly how many meters tall would the pile be?
questions.sourceNote: A standard US paper bill is about 0.109 millimeters thick. Multiply that by 1,000,000 bills, and you get 109,000 millimeters, or 109 meters.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual muscles are working inside a typical caterpillar's tiny body?
questions.sourceNote: While the exact number varies by species, a typical caterpillar has around 4,000 distinct muscles to help articulate its complex segmented body.
questions.didYouKnow: While humans only have about 600 muscles, caterpillars pack over 4,000! They need them to control their intricate segmented bodies.

questions.question: Roughly how many standard 3-megabyte photos can you store on a completely empty 128GB flash drive?
questions.sourceNote: 128 gigabytes is roughly 128,000 megabytes (or up to ~131,000 if using true binary). Divided by 3 megabytes per photo, you get roughly 43,000.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual juicy red seeds are hidden inside a typical average-sized pomegranate?
questions.sourceNote: While an old myth claims they all have exactly 613 seeds, a typical pomegranate actually holds anywhere from 200 to 800 arils, averaging ~600.

questions.question: Roughly how many slimy seeds do you scoop out of an average medium-sized Halloween carving pumpkin?
questions.sourceNote: A typical 10 to 15-pound carving pumpkin usually yields between 400 and 600 seeds depending on its exact size and variety.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual living trees are currently growing on planet Earth right now?
questions.sourceNote: A massive 2015 combination of satellite imagery and ground-count surveys published in Nature estimated 3.04 trillion living trees globally.
questions.didYouKnow: Earth is home to over 3 trillion trees, which means there are roughly 400 trees for every single human living on the planet!

questions.question: If laid perfectly end-to-end, roughly how many miles of blood vessels are inside an average adult human body?
questions.sourceNote: Adults have an estimated 60,000 miles (about 100,000 km) of blood vessels, primarily made up of incredibly dense microscopic capillary networks.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual WhatsApp messages do users worldwide send to each other every single day?
questions.sourceNote: With over 2.7 billion active users globally sending an average of roughly 50 messages per day, the daily total easily clears 100+ billion.

questions.question: If you counted them all up, exactly how many individual seconds are there in a standard 365-day year?
questions.sourceNote: 60 seconds × 60 minutes = 3,600 per hour. 3,600 × 24 hours = 86,400 per day. 86,400 × 365 days = exactly 31,536,000 seconds.

questions.seasonalNote: The NYC Subway opened on this day in 1904!
questions.question: Roughly how many individual subway cars make up the active New York City transit fleet?
questions.sourceNote: To support 28 active routes and 472 stations operating 24/7, the MTA maintains a massive rolling fleet of roughly 6,400 to 6,500 subway cars.
questions.didYouKnow: The NYC subway is the largest rapid transit system in the world by number of stations, operating continuously since October 27, 1904.

questions.question: Roughly how many tiny individual lenses are packed into a single eyeball of a dragonfly?
questions.sourceNote: Dragonflies have giant compound eyes covering most of their head. Each eye contains about 30,000 ommatidia (lenses), granting nearly 360-degree vision.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual metal strings are pulled tight inside a standard grand piano?
questions.sourceNote: While there are 88 keys, most higher notes strike 3 strings each for volume, while thicker bass notes use 1 or 2. This totals roughly 230 strings per piano.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual hairs grow in a typical adult human's single eyebrow?
questions.sourceNote: A typical unplucked eyebrow contains roughly 250 to 300 hairs. Each hair grows for about 3 to 4 months before naturally shedding.

questions.question: Roughly how many times does a standard ceiling fan rotate if you leave it running on medium speed for a full 24 hours?
questions.sourceNote: A standard ceiling fan on medium spins at ~150 RPM. 150 revs × 60 minutes = 9,000 per hour. 9,000 × 24 hours = 216,000 rotations in a full day.

questions.question: Exactly how many physical steps must you climb to reach the crown of the Statue of Liberty?
questions.sourceNote: The official count is exactly 354 steps to walk from the pedestal's main lobby up the spiraling double staircase to the crown.
questions.didYouKnow: The Statue of Liberty's copper skin is incredibly thin—about the thickness of two pennies stacked together! It's supported by a flexible iron framework.

questions.question: At a standard 24 frames per second, exactly how many individual drawings are needed for a classic 90-minute animated movie?
questions.sourceNote: 90 min × 60 sec = 5,400 total seconds. At 24 frames per second, that's 5,400 × 24 = 129,600 individual frames.

questions.question: Roughly how many liters of water does a commercial tree need to absorb to grow one single almond?
questions.sourceNote: Almonds are notoriously thirsty! It takes an estimated 3.2 gallons (about 12 liters) of water to produce just one single nut.

questions.question: Roughly how many times do you completely shed and replace your outer layer of skin over an 80-year lifetime?
questions.sourceNote: Your epidermis turns over roughly every 28 days. Over 80 years, that's 80 yr × ~13 skin cycles per year ≈ 1,040, rounded to 1,000.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual photos are snapped worldwide on smartphones every single day?
questions.sourceNote: Humanity takes about 1.8 trillion photos annually, over 90% of which are on smartphones. 1.8 trillion ÷ 365 days ≈ 5 billion per day.

questions.question: Roughly how many total hours does an average indoor cat sleep over a 15-year lifetime?
questions.sourceNote: ~15 hours of sleep per day × 365 days a year × 15 years ≈ 82,125 total hours of snoozing.

questions.question: Roughly how many individual chocolate chips are inside a standard 12-ounce baking bag?
questions.sourceNote: 12 ounces is ~340 grams. If a single standard chocolate chip weighs about 0.3 grams, a full bag holds roughly 1,100 chips.
questions.didYouKnow: Ruth Wakefield invented the chocolate chip cookie in 1938 when she chopped up a Nestlé bar, expecting it to melt. It didn't, and a classic was born!

questions.question: Roughly how many individual lightning bolts strike the Earth every single day?
questions.sourceNote: Global monitoring shows ~44 lightning strikes per second. 44 strikes × 60s × 60m × 24h ≈ 3.8 million daily strikes!

questions.question: Roughly how many Earth days does it take for Neptune to complete one full orbit around the sun?
questions.sourceNote: Neptune is incredibly far away. One Neptunian year takes roughly 165 Earth years. 165 × 365.25 days ≈ 60,190 days.

questions.question: Roughly how many tiny aerodynamic dimples are pressed into the surface of a standard golf ball?
questions.sourceNote: While there is no fixed rule, most standard golf balls feature between 300 and 400 dimples—often exactly 336—to optimize flight.

questions.question: Roughly how many wrapped fun-size candies fit inside a standard plastic trick-or-treat pumpkin bucket?
questions.sourceNote: ~4-liter bucket × 60% packing efficiency / ~15 milliliters per fun-size candy ≈ 160 candies.

questions.question: By volume, roughly how many planet Earths could you squish inside the Sun?
questions.sourceNote: The Sun's radius is ~109x Earth's. Volume scales by radius cubed (109 × 109 × 109) ≈ 1.3 million.
questions.didYouKnow: The Sun is huge—it accounts for 99.86% of the mass in our entire solar system! It could easily hold over a million Earths inside.

questions.question: Roughly how many physical parking spaces are paved and marked across the entire United States?
questions.sourceNote: ~280M cars in the US × ~7 spots per car on average (home, work, stores, street) ≈ 2 billion spaces.

questions.question: Exactly how many physical keys make up a classic full-size ANSI desktop computer keyboard?
questions.sourceNote: Alphabet (26) + numbers (10) + function (12) + numpad (17) + modifiers & navigation (39) = 104 keys.

questions.question: Roughly how many times does a healthy woodpecker peck a tree in a single day of active foraging?
questions.sourceNote: ~20 pecks per burst × ~60 bursts an hour × 10 active daylight hours ≈ 12,000 pecks per day.

questions.question: How many mosquitoes can a single little brown bat catch and eat in just one hour?
questions.sourceNote: A single little brown bat can consume up to 1,000 tiny flying insects like mosquitoes in a single hour of hunting.

questions.question: If you pack a standard bed pillowcase to the brim with Halloween candy, roughly how many calories are you hauling?
questions.sourceNote: A 20-lb pillowcase holds ~9,000 grams of candy. With mixed chocolate and sugar averaging ~4.5 calories per gram, 9,000 × 4.5 ≈ 40,500 calories.

questions.question: Walking through a spooky forest, roughly how many individual spiders are living in a single acre of woodland?
questions.sourceNote: Biologists estimate 1-2 million spiders per acre of undisturbed woodland or meadow, which breaks down to about 25 spiders per square foot.

questions.question: Roughly how many times has the official music video for Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' been viewed on YouTube?
questions.sourceNote: A perennial Halloween classic, the official short film for 'Thriller' recently crossed the massive 1 billion view milestone on YouTube.

questions.question: Roughly how many people's skeletal remains are stacked inside the famous underground Paris Catacombs?
questions.sourceNote: The official ossuary contains the transferred remains of an estimated 6 million Parisians, moved from overflowing cemeteries starting in the 1780s.
questions.didYouKnow: The tunnels were created in the late 1700s to solve severe health problems caused by overflowing city cemeteries. It took 12 years to move all the bones!
